question: At the frozen 32-sample Eevee baseline, does rendering a frame in a newly launched Blender process restore strict decoded-pixel reproducibility relative to rendering the complete 1-144 timeline in one process?

evidenceBasis.selectionRule: Use frame 1 as the process-start anchor, plus every frame that failed decoded-pixel equality in at least four of the seven frozen 32-sample, dither-zero sequence comparisons listed below.

design.type: two-mode process-history isolation with three independent replicates per mode

modes.description: One newly launched Blender process renders every frame 1-144 in ascending order; sentinel outputs are the primary comparison subset.
Each sentinel frame and replicate is rendered by its own newly launched Blender process, which exits after that one frame.

exactGate.perMode: All 12 sentinel frames must be exact in all three within-mode replicate pairs.
exactGate.crossMode: All 12 sentinel frames must be exact in all nine history-to-fresh replicate pairs.

decisionRule.FRESH_PROCESS_RESTORES_EXACTNESS: FRESH passes its complete within-mode gate and HISTORY does not, with a valid experiment.
decisionRule.HISTORY_PROCESS_ONLY_EXACT: HISTORY passes its complete within-mode gate and FRESH does not, with a valid experiment.
decisionRule.NO_HISTORY_EFFECT_DETECTED: Both modes pass their within-mode gates and every cross-mode sentinel comparison is exact, with a valid experiment.
decisionRule.DETERMINISTIC_HISTORY_EFFECT: Both modes pass their within-mode gates but at least one cross-mode sentinel comparison is non-exact, with a valid experiment.
decisionRule.PROCESS_ISOLATION_NOT_SUFFICIENT: Neither mode passes its complete within-mode gate, with a valid experiment.
decisionRule.INVALID_EXPERIMENT: Any frozen identity, source/configuration observation, process-boundary, image/binding, count or negative-case gate fails.

requiredNegativeCases: Fast GI differs from fixed true
TAA reprojection differs from fixed true
history run omits or reorders a frame
fresh invocation renders more than one frame
fresh process ID aliases another experimental process
comparison is not bound to both image hashes
explicitNonClaims: The twelve sentinel frames are a pre-registered diagnostic subset and do not estimate failure probability for all frames or scenes.
A fresh-process result does not identify a specific Blender source-level race, cache or random-number mechanism.
The HISTORY and FRESH modes intentionally differ in prior rendered-frame history; the experiment tests that boundary, not render-speed equivalence.
Three replicates can falsify exact determinism but cannot estimate a stable mismatch rate.
No perceptual tolerance is selected and near-equality remains non-exact.
The result applies only to this Blender 5.2 Eevee PNG8 same-machine profile, not Cycles EXR masters or other devices.
A favorable fresh-process result would be an engineering clue, not yet a cost-effective production workflow recommendation.
